Qaamuus focus analysis: bay = baa + ay
principle: In the reviewed object-focus frame, the explicit noun subject controls both the contracted focus/subject clitic and the finite verb. The intervening focused object does not control agreement.
safety: Do not infer objecthood from buu/bay/ayuu/ayay alone. Only lemmas with independent reviewed object-focus evidence are executable. Unknown verbs and other focus roles remain unjudged. leeyahay possession focus is owned by the more specific possession rule.
note: Review-only. No automatic rewrite of the clitic or verb is produced.
